x-comment: LOCAL DEVELOPMENT manifest. Not a Flathub submission. A Flathub manifest must be written by a human and must not contain AI-generated or AI-assisted content.
x-comment-locales: Keep every translation in the app itself. A split .Locale extension only installs the system's languages, so the in-app language preference could not switch to any other.
x-comment-pkg-config-path: PKG_CONFIG_PATH gains /app/lib64/pkgconfig. flatpak-builder's own build env covers /app/lib/pkgconfig only, and it passes --libdir=/app/lib; a builder that does not pass that (as on some distro builds of flatpak-builder) leaves meson's platform default, which resolved to /app/lib64 in CI and put libspelling's .pc where pkg-config never looks. Covering both layouts costs nothing and keeps the build working whichever libdir the SDK ends up with.
